clues.q: Bilbo's young relative and heir, who carries the Ring to Mordor.
Frodo's gardener and most loyal friend.
Merry is short for this name.
Pippin's family name, which was also the family name of Bilbo's mother.
The hobbit Sam marries when he gets home to the Shire.
The dragon who sleeps on the treasure inside the Lonely Mountain.
Bilbo wins the Ring from this creature in a game of riddles.
The proud leader of the thirteen dwarves.
The man of Lake-town who shoots Smaug with the Black Arrow.
The skin-changer who can turn into a huge black bear.
I'm a wizard in a grey cloak and a tall pointed hat, and I love fireworks.
I'm an elf with a bow, and I have an orc-counting contest with a dwarf.
I'm a dwarf with an axe, and I become best friends with an elf.
People call me Strider, but I'm really the heir to the throne of Gondor.
I'm the son of Gondor's Steward, and I try to take the Ring from Frodo.
The green, peaceful land where the hobbits live.
The hidden valley where Elrond lives.
The volcano where the Ring was made, and the only place it can be destroyed.
The great white city of Gondor, built in seven levels.
The ancient dwarf kingdom under the mountains where Gandalf falls with the Balrog.
Bilbo's little elvish blade, which glows blue when orcs are near.
Bilbo gives Frodo a shirt of rings made of this light, super-strong metal.
Aragorn's sword, reforged from the broken pieces of Narsil.
The great white gem that Thorin wants more than all the rest of the treasure.
Gandalf's sword, found in the trolls' cave in The Hobbit.
The Dark Lord who made the One Ring.
The white wizard of Isengard who turns traitor.
The nine Ringwraiths, or Black Riders, are also called this.
The giant spider who lurks in the pass of Cirith Ungol.
Saruman's servant, who whispers poison into King Théoden's ear.
The King of Rohan, freed from Saruman's spell by Gandalf.
Théoden's niece, who rides to battle in disguise.
The fortress of Rohan where Saruman's army attacks at night.
The lord of all horses, who carries Gandalf.
The Steward of Gondor and father of Boromir and Faramir.
The giant tree-shepherds of Fangorn Forest.
The oldest of the Ents, who carries Merry and Pippin.
The Ents attack and flood this stronghold of Saruman.
The cheerful master of the Old Forest who saves the hobbits from Old Man Willow.
In The Hobbit, the Wood-elves of this dark forest lock the dwarves up.
The Lady of Lothlórien.
Arwen's father, the Lord of Rivendell.
Galadriel gives Frodo a glass phial holding the light of this star.
The elvish waybread that keeps a traveler going all day.
Galadriel gives Sam a box of earth and a silver seed of this kind of tree.
Hobbits don't wear shoes, because these are tough and hairy.
Bilbo's comfortable home in Hobbiton.
On their birthdays, hobbits don't get presents. Instead they do this.
clues.a: What is give presents to others?

clues.q: Bilbo's big birthday party is for turning this age, which he calls eleventy-one.
The tavern in Bree where the hobbits first meet Strider.
Putting the Ring on makes you this.
Fiery letters appear on the Ring when Gandalf throws it into this.
The rhyme says Seven rings were given to the lords of this people.
Gollum's name before the Ring changed him.
The Ring's inscription is written in this language of Mordor.
The author of The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.
Tolkien was a professor at this famous English university.
Tolkien and C.S. Lewis were members of this writers' club that read their stories aloud to each other.
Tolkien invented elvish languages. One is Quenya; the other main one is this.
The Inklings often met at this Oxford pub, nicknamed the Bird and Baby.
clues.a: What is the Eagle and Child?

final.clue: It was said no man could kill the Witch-king. He is struck down by Éowyn and this hobbit, who stabs him from behind.
